args.body:
Summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.tamarack.example/freight/companion):

- Freight spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
args.title: Tamarack freight blog + companion — combined summary
